item.title: Petition: Pass Oregon House Bill 4134 for Wildlife Funding
item.description: Oregon’s wildlife is in trouble, and House Bill 4134 offers a rare fix everyone can live with. The bill would raise the statewide lodging tax by 1.25% and generate an estimated $38 million a year to restore habitat, reduce poaching, tackle invasive species, address wildfire damage, and compensate ranchers for wolf related livestock losses.
